# Monika Engineers

Monika Engineers is an industrial automation company based in Millerganj, Ludhiana, Punjab, India. The business was established in 1996 and serves factories, OEMs, machine builders, panel builders and maintenance teams across Punjab and India.

## Core capabilities

- Industrial automation product selection and supply
- In-house PLC, VFD, MCC, PCC and APFC control-panel manufacturing
- PLC, HMI, drive and SCADA programming and system integration
- Installation and commissioning support
- AC drive, servo drive and industrial electronics diagnosis and repair
- Sourcing replacements for obsolete automation components

## Products

Monika Engineers supplies variable frequency drives (VFDs), PLCs, HMIs, AC servo drives and motors, switchgear, circuit breakers, contactors, sensors, limit switches, temperature controllers, timers, counters, relays, encoders, SMPS units, terminals and panel accessories.

## Brands

Core brands include Delta Electronics, Inovance, Chint, Selec, BCH, Lubi and Teknic. The company also supplies products from Omron, WAGO, Schneider Electric, Panasonic, Yaskawa, Baumer, Nidec and other established automation brands.

Monika Engineers was presented by Inovance as its trusted channel partner at MACHAUTO EXPO 2026 in Ludhiana.
